Dashboard Control PostureLink

Control FieldCurrent StandardFounder Use
Layer statusActive founder control and decision-readiness layerUse dashboards to see posture, tension, escalation, and next control route.
Primary purposeConvert source records into founder-readable intervention, cadence, risk, and gate-control views.Gives the founder a cockpit without turning dashboards into working files.
Source ruleUpdate CRM, operations, compliance, archive, SOP, shipment, task, and source rooms first, then refresh dashboards.Prevents polished dashboards from outrunning the records that own proof.
Decision ruleFounder decisions must trace back to the live room, board, packet, claim, shipment, task, or owner record that holds evidence.Keeps approvals, releases, and exceptions route-backed.
Protection ruleDashboards may summarize protected template standards but must not mutate protected template masters or approved brand assets.Preserves template and brand integrity while dashboard views evolve.

Source Ownership StandardLink

Dashboard UseSource Room Still OwnsRequired Founder Behavior
Summary postureCRM, operations, compliance, archive, SOP, shipment, task, or template-protected source records.Treat dashboard status as a readout, not a substitute for the source record.
Release or gate decisionRelease room, funding room, document-control packet, executable-check board, and trust posture record.Confirm executable proof before movement widens.
Commercial confidenceLead, customer, supplier, active deal, won deal, lost deal, pricing, cash, and revenue records.Keep forecast and commercial banding tied to source proof.
Compliance confidenceTraceability, complaint, CAPA, inspection, supplier approval, and shipment-review records.Keep closure language bounded until evidence agrees.
Archive confidenceActive source record and archive closeout route.Do not archive while any live source answer can still change.

TriggerRequired Dashboard MoveFounder Protection

Customer, supplier, release, or communication timing weakensOpen 06_dashboard/37_response-escalation/Counterparty-Response-SLA-and-Escalation-Board.md.Prevents silence from being treated as acceptance.
Cash, concentration, or capital pressure risesOpen 06_dashboard/19_cash-forecast/Cash-Forecast-and-Exposure-Outlook.md, 06_dashboard/20_concentration-risk/Portfolio-Concentration-Review.md, and 06_dashboard/24_capital-allocation/Capital-Allocation-and-Release-Priority-Review.md.Keeps scarce resources behind evidence-backed priorities.

Dashboard DisciplineLink

DisciplineRequired BehaviorEscalation Trigger
Evidence ownershipDashboards summarize linked records; they do not replace rooms, packets, claims, shipments, approvals, or task records.Any dashboard becomes the only place where status, owner, or proof exists.
Decision traceabilityAny release, override, archive, capital, supplier, or communication decision should trace back to the accountable source record.Founder approval is requested from a dashboard alone.
Founder control surfaceDashboards are decision-readiness surfaces, not loose operating storage.Working files, drafts, or proof packets appear inside dashboard folders.
Template and brand protectionDashboards may link to approved standards but should not change protected template masters or approved brand assets.Dashboard cleanup touches 01_templates/ or approved brand compositions.
Cadence integrityDaily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly surfaces should answer different time horizons.Same-day pressure starts rewriting quarterly direction without the plan and assumption boards.
